Rachel: Heads-up: planned rolling reboots + node-label compaction in us-west2 Tue 02:00-03:00 UTC. 3 waves of 4 hosts.
Diego: Will models be redirected?
Rachel: Yes — route to burst/dedicated; enable variant-small fallback for top tenants.
Lena: Pre-seed KV caches 20m before each wave (use seed=2025 for deterministic results).
ops-bot: estimated burst cost ~0.3% monthly infra if fully used. Will alert if >0.7%.
Diego: Add 5m drain grace for local-data eviction. Use: `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300 --timeout=10m`.
Rachel: Owners: wave1 Diego, wave2 Lena, wave3 Rachel. Smoke checks after each wave.
Rachel: Abort criteria: p95 > 700ms for >3m or errors >2% -> pause and rollback router change. Pagerduty per runbook.
ops-bot: scheduled_maintenance created id=sm-2027101234567 start=2025-08-19T02:00:00Z notify=[#eng-infra,#support] pagerduty=on-high-error
Diego: I'll watch dashboards and be on preflight at 01:30 UTC.
Lena: I'll run kv-seed and post hit-rate numbers after each wave.
Rachel: Thanks all  I'll update the maintenance ticket and pin the checklist in channel.
